description: Equal decimals group and deduplicate together, whatever their written scale.
program: (let [d (fn [s] (match (decimal.parse s) (some x) x none (decimal.from-int 0)))] {:distinct (map decimal.show (distinct-by identity [(d "1.50") (d "1.5") (d "2")])) :groups (map (fn [g] (count (nth g 1))) (group-by identity [(d "1.0") (d "1") (d "2") (d "1.00")]))})
